lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 closed the round-1 WARNING at events.ts:494: doc comments describing the escalation contract were left stale by the US-002/US-003 independent oracle-lint/auditor budget split. Mechanical sweep applied to every site the reviewer named, all now reading '...the re-plan budget matching the latest block's origin is exhausted (MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS for auditor-origin, MAX_LINT_REPLAN_ROUNDS for oracle-lint-origin, US-002, CAM-448, ADR-0052)' instead of the stale single-budget 'exhausts MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS' phrasing: events.ts:72 (module event-list doc) and :494 (PlanEscalatedEventDetail doc); plan-runner.ts:248 (plan-escalated PlanPhaseResult kind doc), :1472 (writeEscalationMarkerFn seam doc), :1526-1527 (runPlanPhaseWithReplan function headline, also fixed an awkward mid-sentence line break introduced by the edit), :2160-2161 (plan-escalated handler comment); plan-escalation.ts:5-9 (module header) and :22-24 (PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME doc); sidecar.ts:2396 (makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn doc). No behavior change, comments only. The file-size gate tripped on all three touched production files (sidecar.ts 3703->3705, events.ts 922->927, plan-runner.ts 2194->2202) purely from the added comment lines; ceilings raised to the gate-measured content.split('\n').length actuals with a dated _ref entry naming this story, staged in the same commit. Full bun test (5758 pass / 0 fail) and bun run check:all both green. This was the LAST passes:false story in prd.json (jq confirms US-R1-002 was the only remaining non-passing entry before the supervisor flips it): the next agent invocation should find PRD_COMPLETE unless the supervisor's terminal-verdict hook files new round-2 fixes off the two SUGGESTIONs still open in prd.json's review.findings (plan-runner.ts:1448's PlanEscalationWriterParams optional-vs-required exhaustedBudget tightening; plan-runner-replan.test.ts:366's uncovered interleaved lint+auditor+lint summed-bound case) or off a fresh review round.
